title: Bridging the Data Gap: Creating a Hindi Text Summarization Dataset from the English XSUM

bias_targets.methodology: The paper addresses English-centric bias in natural language processing by creating and evaluating a Hindi text summarization dataset. The methodology evaluates cross-lingual translation quality using automated metrics (BLEU, BERTScore, CHRF, COMET, TER) to ensure linguistic fidelity and mitigate underrepresentation of low-resource languages.

Human evaluation and annotation of translated Hindi summaries using a custom UI (Doccano) that includes a specific 'Gender issue' tag to flag, evaluate, and correct gender-related translation errors (such as incorrect gender agreement or default masculine pronoun generation).

Qualitative evaluation through human annotation guidelines, which instruct human reviewers to evaluate generated summaries to ensure they do not introduce or propagate any biases that were not present in the original English source texts.
